/.title: Flagcn: Accessible Flag Components for shadcn/ui
/.description: Install 306 accessible React flags plus country, phone, language, and currency components with the shadcn CLI. Source-owned and ready to customize.

/flags.title: Browse 306 React Flag Components | Flagcn
/flags.description: Search flags by name, ISO code, native name, calling code, currency, or language. Preview formats and ratios, copy JSX, install, or download.

/docs.title: Flagcn Documentation: shadcn Flag Registry
/docs.description: Learn how to install and use Flagcn, an accessible React flag registry for shadcn/ui with typed components, four formats, and flexible ratios.

/docs/introduction.title: Introduction to Flagcn | shadcn Flag Registry
/docs/introduction.description: Understand how Flagcn delivers source-owned, accessible React flag components through the shadcn CLI without a runtime package.

/docs/installation.title: Install Flagcn with the shadcn CLI
/docs/installation.description: Configure the @flagcn registry and install one flag, the Flag primitive, FlagPicker, or all 306 React flag components with the shadcn CLI.

/docs/flag.title: React Flag Component API and Props | Flagcn
/docs/flag.description: Use the typed Flag React component with accessible alt text, SVG or raster formats, 4:3, square, and original ratios, classes, refs, and image props.

/docs/flag-picker.title: Accessible FlagPicker Component | Flagcn
/docs/flag-picker.description: Add a searchable, keyboard-ready React flag picker with controlled state, hidden form fields, format and ratio options, and accessible labels.

/docs/country-picker.title: CountryPicker and CountrySelect for shadcn | Flagcn
/docs/country-picker.description: Build searchable or native country controls with typed ISO values, calling codes, native names, and theme-native shadcn styling.

/docs/phone-input.title: International Phone Input for shadcn | Flagcn
/docs/phone-input.description: Add an international PhoneInput with searchable flags, national formatting, E.164 output, country inference, validation metadata, and shadcn styling.

/docs/country-display.title: Country Badges and Flag Avatars for shadcn | Flagcn
/docs/country-display.description: Use compact CountryBadge and FlagAvatar components that inherit your project's shadcn Badge, Avatar, colors, radius, and typography.

/docs/locale-pickers.title: Language and Currency Pickers for shadcn | Flagcn
/docs/locale-pickers.description: Add searchable LanguagePicker and CurrencyPicker controls with native labels, RTL metadata, ISO codes, symbols, and locale-aware currency values.

/docs/formats-and-ratios.title: Flag Formats and Ratios | Flagcn
/docs/formats-and-ratios.description: Choose SVG, PNG, WebP, or JPEG flags in no-crop 4:3, 1:1 square, or original frames and understand the asset source used for each option.

/docs/styling.title: Style React Flag Components | Flagcn
/docs/styling.description: Style Flagcn components with className, inline styles, native image attributes, responsive sizing, borders, and the design tokens in your shadcn app.

/docs/accessibility.title: Accessible Flag Components | Flagcn
/docs/accessibility.description: Use meaningful alternative text, decorative flags, keyboard navigation, explicit picker labels, and inclusive flag semantics in React applications.

/docs/ai-agents.title: Flagcn Registry for AI Coding Agents
/docs/ai-agents.description: Give AI coding agents exact Flagcn registry routes, component contracts, safe defaults, accessibility guidance, and machine-readable llms.txt instructions.

/docs/data-utilities.title: Country Data, Calling Codes, Emoji and Collections | Flagcn
/docs/data-utilities.description: Use typed country metadata, reversible flag emoji helpers, shared calling-code lookups, and current GCC and EU country collections.

/docs/license.title: Flagcn License and Artwork Sources
